title: The first letter
logline: A licensing letter. Wood uses it to level the drafting table.

panels.composition: The garage. An envelope, heavy, embossed: a company logo. WOOD opening it. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a young man opening a heavy embossed business envelope at a garage drafting table, a small dog watching, muddy digital flats

panels.composition: The letter, drawn as a block of typed text with only a few words legible: 'ROLFCOPTR' · 'license' · 'plush' · 'territories' · a number with commas.
props: letter with a few legible words

image.prompt: close-up of a typed business letter with most of the text as gray lines and only a few words legible, an embossed letterhead
image.notes: Legible words: ROLFCOPTR · license · plush · territories · a number with commas. Letter after.

panels.composition: Wood folding the letter in half. In quarters. In eighths.

image.prompt: a young man folding a letter smaller and smaller with great precision, no words

panels.composition: The folded letter wedged under the short leg of the drafting table. Wood testing the table: level. He goes back to drawing. The dog approves.
props: folded letter under the table leg

image.prompt: close-up of a tightly folded letter wedged under the short leg of a drafting table, a young man's hand testing the table's level, a dog nearby

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: The first refusal. The letter becomes a shim. The table has been uneven since 2004.
